verdict.rationale: ReelMimic's core workflow is delegating to an in-product AI. You drop in a reference, say what you want, chat to refine the plan, and approve. Up to 6 agents then build the video, cross-review each shot, and expose their reasoning and logs, and you can request changes in the side chat or by commenting on the video. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration (all evidence is the vendor's own README), and the AI depends on the user's own Claude Code or Codex setup rather than a bundled model.
